title: Abandoned House Part 4: Kitchen 😱
caption: Part 4 of turning one abandoned house into a luxury home 🏚️➡️✨ Rate this kitchen makeover from 1 to 10 👇
narration: Most people would have given up on this kitchen. They scrubbed every surface. They fitted new cabinets. And then they added modern lighting. Now it looks like a five-star luxury kitchen. In part 5, you choose the next room. Follow so you don't miss it. And it all started... right here.
alt_titles: Part 4: This Kitchen Was a Disaster 😳
